    How this sandbox works
    

      This document is the extension ui file, framed with
      sandbox and no allow-same-origin. It cannot read
      your session or the callback token. Compose here, then paste into Ordryn
      or run the curl with $CALLBACK_TOKEN from a rotate on the form above.
    

    
    
      
  • Fields: standup.last (date), standup.notes (markdown)
    • 
      
  • Callback: POST /api/v2/ext/callback with comment or set_field
